idea-plugin.name: GNU Global C/C++ . Config Pack
idea-plugin.description:
21 rules that read the values in a shared .vscode folder, plus 45 snippets. VS Code loads a wrong value without a word - this names the line and the fix.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → GNU Global C/C++ . Config Pack: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 21 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/gnu-global-cpp-vscode-config-pack (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/gnu-global-cpp-vscode-config-pack
